newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures finish sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures finish sharply lower.

text.p: Jan 22 - Most IMM currency futures ended sharply lower as dollar bulls reigned. March marks ended just above contract low set in GLOBEX, as dollar bulls kept eyes on 1.57 dollar/mark upside. Support at $0.6092, or about 1.6470 spot. Sterling crumbled to the lowest price since early December amid technical breakdown, panic selling, traders said.
